theorem_title: The active-count budget has the certified power exponent
theorem_natural_language_statement:
For every natural input-value exponent $k$, the active-count function at the uniform false-incidence budget has power bound $$2-\varepsilon\left(\tfrac12-s-\kappa-r_H(1+b-2s)\right),$$ where $s$ is the band shift, $\kappa$ the fixed schedule constant, $r_H$ the entropy ratio, and $b$ the box saving.

This exponent bounds the active wanted work after the executed false-incidence budget is applied.
